title: Level 906 - "The Cygnus Archive"
survival_class: Safe and sound. / Devoid of harm. / It is a pleasure to meet you.
physical_identity: A massive, seemingly endless library in gothic, Victorian and baroque style: wooden shelves (some floating), blue velvet carpets with gold ornament, candelabra light, a stained-glass painted ceiling that cannot be reached.
scale_topology: Endless-seeming indoor library with a central office, tea room and variable guest rooms.
anomalies: Books spawn and clip in and out
lighting_sound: Candelabras hanging from a very high ceiling light the whole library; sound not stated.

entities.name: Blanche
entities.behavior: Unique librarian entity; hosts tea; warns, lectures, immobilises, expels rude visitors

entities.name: Tom Von Haderach
entities.behavior: Blanche's butler and protege; occupies a guest room

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Blanche, Tom Von Haderach, Light Guides
items_communities: Books and scrolls bearing Blanche's signature
No bases, communities or outposts; some guests stay weeks or months

entrances.from: Any level containing Blanche's signed book or document
entrances.method: Drag index finger over Blanche's signature left to right
entrances.conditions: Sometimes a touch suffices; copies and photos fail
entrances.quote: The only known way to enter the Cygnus Archive

exits.to: Safe level of the visitor's choice
Entry level if safe, else a safe level
exits.quote: forcefully teleported out of the level, back to where you were

signature_mechanic: Etiquette-governed hosting: polite visitors get tea and a guided exit; rude ones are warned, lectured, immobilised and expelled. Entry only via Blanche's signature.
verticality: Ladders to floating shelves; very high unreachable ceiling.
do_not: Add hazards or real Witnessing the Beyond
conflicts_notes: Log 906-1 is linked, not captured. Levels 905 and 907 appear only in the link list. Class lines are phrases, not a numeric class.
